e: North Korea launches multiple ballistic missiles from the vicinity of Pyongyang.
Kim Yo Jong states that her country carried out a intermediate-range missile test.
Ukraine announces that two North Korean soldiers that had been captured while fighting for Russia had been transferred to South Korea.
North Korea launches an unidentified projectile at the Sea of Japan.
The first road bridge connecting Russia and North Korea is opened over the Tumen River between Rason and Khasan.
North Korea fires a missile from Wonsan into the Sea of Japan.
North Korea launches a short-range ballistic missile into the Sea of Japan.
Xi Jinping, the General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party, visits North Korea and meets with General Secretary Kim Jong Un after seven years.
North Korea launches several close-range ballistic missiles at Yellow Sea.
Naegohyang Women's FC wins the 2025–26 AFC Women's Champions League after defeating Tokyo Verdy Beleza 1–0 at the final in South Korea.
Naegohyang Women's FC defeats South Korean side Suwon FC Women at the semifinals of the AFC Women's Champions League in Suwon.
Naegohyang Women's FC arrive in South Korea to compete at the AFC Women's Champions League in Suwon, the first time a North Korean sports team has been sent to the South since 2018.
A museum and memorial dedicated to the North Korean involvement in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present) is opened in Pyongyang.
North Korea carries out a ballistic missile test into the Sea of Japan involving cluster munitions.
KCNA says that the country has tested various military technologies throughout the week including a surface-to-surface tactical missile called Hwasongpho-11 Ka.
Belarusian president Alexander Lukashenko visits Kim Jong-un in Pyongyang.
Following the 2026 North Korean parliamentary election, Kim Jong Un is reelected chairman of the State Affairs Commission (head of State) and Pak Thae-song is reappointed as Premier.
North Korea qualifies for the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup after defeating Chinese Taipei 4–0 during the 2026 AFC Women's Asian Cup playoffs in Australia.
North Korea fires 10 ballistic missiles into the Sea of Japan from a launch site in Sunan.
Train services between Beijing and Pyongyang resume for after a suspension imposed in 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
General Secretary Kim Jong-un reaffirms North Korea's relations with China in a letter written to General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party Xi Jinping.
North Korea carries out a ballistic missile test over the Sea of Japan.

The Tokyo District Court in Japan orders North Korea to pay 88 million yen ($570,000) in compensation to four Zainichi Koreans who were lured to move to the country through propaganda schemes but instead experienced inappropriate conditions before escaping.
Kim Jong-un dismisses Yang Sung-ho as vice premier in charge of machinery after publicly accusing him of incompetence.
North Korea carries out a ballistic missile test over the Sea of Japan.
